default: plain `go build` of the idiomatic source, the baseline
optimized: same source, gc and linker flags (no inlining, no bounds checks, -s -w, dead strip), then a generic post-link strip
extreme: Go logic compiled by TinyGo with no runtime, raw syscalls, and generic post-link header surgery (golfed ELF header on Linux, one folded 16 KB page on macOS)
extreme-ffi: macOS only: like extreme, but the OS is reached through libSystem with FFI and no assembly at all; one page plus a few bytes of bind opcodes
tinygo: the idiomatic source built with TinyGo's small runtime instead of gc (hello only on macOS, where TinyGo's net cannot dial)
upx: Linux only: the optimized binary compressed with UPX --best --lzma, unpacked in memory at run time
